commands.command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== SILENT REFERENCE DTMF 1 ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo ref_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && OFF=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; sleep 6; rm -f /tmp/ref-ui.xml /tmp/ref-keypad.xml; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell rm -f /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-ui.xml /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-keypad.xml; OK=0; for i in $(seq 1 5); do adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-ui.xml >/tmp/uiauto1.out 2>&1 && adb -s "$SERIAL" pull /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-ui.xml /tmp/ref-ui.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && OK=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; cat /tmp/uiauto1.out || true; test "$OK" = "1"; DIGIT=$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'from s22_call_control import find_node_bounds; s=open("/tmp/ref-ui.xml").read(); print(find_node_bounds(s,["1"],exact=True) or "")'); if [ -z "$DIGIT" ]; then KP=$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'from s22_call_control import find_node_bounds,KEYPAD_LABELS; s=open("/tmp/ref-ui.xml").read(); print(find_node_bounds(s,KEYPAD_LABELS) or "")'); test -n "$KP"; XY=$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import sys; from s22_call_control import center_from_bounds; print(*center_from_bounds(sys.argv[1]))' "$KP"); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 1.0; OK=0; for i in $(seq 1 8); do adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-keypad.xml >/tmp/uiauto2.out 2>&1 && adb -s "$SERIAL" pull /data/local/tmp/phase1c-ref-keypad.xml /tmp/ref-keypad.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && OK=1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; cat /tmp/uiauto2.out || true; test "$OK" = "1"; DIGIT=$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'from s22_call_control import find_node_bounds; s=open("/tmp/ref-keypad.xml").read(); print(find_node_bounds(s,["1"],exact=True) or "")'); fi; test -n "$DIGIT"; XY=$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import sys; from s22_call_control import center_from_bounds; print(*center_from_bounds(sys.argv[1]))' "$DIGIT"); set -- $XY; echo digit1_tap=$1,$2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 0.35; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 2500 /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; echo silent_reference_capture=true
